flags: CRITERIA / DROP CANDIDATE (lot allowance): area page 'Things to Do When You Visit': 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; 'This area provides access to the Chariton River, but there is no boat ramp.' 2.5 acres. The map (© 03/08, titled 'Elmer A. Cook Access, 3 acres') legend is Boundary, Paved Road, Gravel Road, Drainage, Parking Lot, Forest - no camping symbol; it draws one short gravel lane off Highway 11 ending in a parking lot. MDC's GIS camping layer has no point; the parking layer has one lot (50, 'Paved', Allows_Trailers 'No'). The regulations on the page restrict vehicles to 'graveled and paved roads and established parking areas', so a vehicle camper can only be in that lot: a gravel turnaround ~30 x 40 m at the end of a ~70 m lane off the highway, beside the bridge, in floodplain woods. That is the lot-allowance pattern the brief drops (Cross Timbers, Dodd Access, Bird's Blue Hole). A 23-ft rig could turn in it; no ford/4WD wording.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the lot's west edge is ~25-35 m from the Chariton (~30-40 m wide here) through a wooded bank (0.30 m/px frame); no opening to the water.
